newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AIF welcomes Sydney light rail plans.
newsitem.headline: AIF welcomes Sydney light rail plans.

text.p: Hastings Funds Management Ltd, manager of the Australian Infrastructure Group (AIF), said on Wednesday it welcomed the New South Wales state government approval to the proposed Sydney light rail system extentions.
The proposal will now enter the formal development approval process including preparation of an Environmental impact Statement, Hastings Fund said.
AIF has a 38.89 percent equity interest in Sydney Light Rail Company Limited (SLRC) which has developed the initial stage of the light rail system and is due to commence operation in late July 1997.
The proposed extensions will also be developed by SLRC and will link Sydney's inner western suburbs with the central business district via Central Station running through to Circular Quay.
